section_summary.extract_value: This section details the analytic strategy used in the study. It describes the use of analysis of variance to assess the effect of training design elements on trainees' performance at three time points, including adaptive transfer. It then focuses on evaluating hypotheses using a moderated structural equation model (MSEM) with LISREL 8.52, outlining the procedure by Mathieu, Tannenbaum, and Salas (1992). The section also explains the creation of composite measures for latent variables such as state prove orientation and state avoid orientation, and the use of single indicators for objective measures of adaptive transfer performance.
